item.title: SOCCER ROUNDUP: East Union prevails in top-10 showdown with Johansen
item.description: Yandel Gutierrez’s goal contributions catapulted the East Union boys soccer team to a 2-1 win over visiting Johansen on Tuesday in a battle between two highly-ranked teams.

item.description: Manteca Unified School District has selected 2025-2026 Employees of the Year.

item.title: Wreath placing on veterans’ graves takes place Saturday
item.description: National Wreaths Across America Day is this Saturday. The East Union Cemetery will honor local heroes on this day thanks to the efforts of Manteca City Ambassador Nihar Jain and his initiative to organize the special ceremony that begins at noon. This calls for those in attendance to remember and honor the country’s fallen heroes with the act of saying their names out aloud during the Wreath Placement that’s scheduled to immediately follow the ceremony. item.title: Manteca Chamber releases winners of Christmas parade
item.description: Manteca’s 53rd annual Christmas parade was viewed by upwards of 7,000 people lining Yosemite Avenue on Saturday evening.

item.title: Local students compete in countywide spelling bee
item.description: G-e-n-e-a-l-o-g-y. That was the winning word at last week’s San Joaquin County Spelling Bee Championship in the Junior Division.

item.title: UP train strikes a wheelchair caught in tracks
item.description: A Union Pacific train slammed into a wheelchair on the Yosemite Avenue crossing in downtown Manteca after an individual had to abandon it when a wheel got caught in the tracks.

item.title: WATER RATES GOING UP BUT NOT DUE TO RAW WATER COST
item.description: A pending 334 percent hike in the cost of raw water the City of Manteca secures through the South San Joaquin Irrigation District won’t impact municipal water rates for at least four years.
